skills.name: blog-publisher
skills.description: Publish a blog post to the F9XR Dev9b Hugo site on GitHub Pages. Generates Hugo front-matter, Markdown body, SEO metadata, the F9XR branding, and runs the publish-gate quality check before shipping.

skills.name: mindmap
skills.description: Turn content such as a blog post, draft, plan, or topic into a structured mind map. Outputs a Mermaid mindmap diagram plus a Markdown tree fallback, and can embed either into a Hugo post on Dev9b.
